notes.title: RUNNING THROUGH RUSSIA 2
notes.content:
Hello ladies and [strike]drunkmen[/strike]jentlemen!
Today is a great day for all of us. We're presenting you...
[h1]RUNNING THROUGH RUSSIA 2[/h1]
You all wanted it, right?
Run on the Earth, in the heaven and hell like in a good old times!
Also, run through:
[list]
[*] Ni Store - because gopniks need phones, right?
[*] Police department - because you shoudn't fight in public places
[*] Mental hospital - because belochka isn't good...
[*] Trash heap - just because you can!
[/list]
Aaaaaand... [b]GET 2048 ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
Now there are:
[list]
[*] 3 different fonts
[*] 8 different backgrounds
[*] Russian and English alphabets, digits and some symbols
[/list]
Aaaaand... [b]THERE ARE 128 UNIQUE ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
If you love challenges - try to get them all!

Finally:
[list]
[*] No more stucking in bears/bottles/matreshkas/etc.
[*] Stable gameplay and stable achievements
[*] A lot of stats
[*] HARDBASS
[*] And lots of fun!
[/list]

Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/870080/Running_Through_Russia_2/]Running Through Russia 2[/url] and have fun!

notes.title: BIG AND SPOOKY HALLOWEEN UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1]Yay! Finally, after months of silence, a BIG update is released![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28140389/c52f12d6bb9d58188e296449cfd17d26025ed5f6.png[/img]

Hello ladies and [strike]gopniks[/strike] gentlemens!
Today, after big while we're ready to present you an very [b]big update[/b] we were telling you about many-many-many times. 
We're added and reworked so many things so we can't list them all there (really!). 

[b]Shortly:
[list]
[*] No more stucking in bears.
[*] Added skin system. Meet new character - Gopnik!
[*] Reworked adaptive interface. Now, any aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, 21:9) works well.
[*] Optimized game (a little). 
[*] Fixed many little (and big) old bugs.
[*] Also, added some new bugs. 
[/list][/b]


[h1]And, today, we're presenting Halloween update![/h1]

Zombie-player, bears with pumpkin on their head, dark spooky backgrounds. All what you love. 

[b]We're still in early access, so write about bugs in game discussions.[/b] 
[i]Hope you'll enjoy. 
AVP[/i]

notes.title: Second day fixes
notes.content:
We're published in Steam only two days ago and you sent us a lot of bugs. After all, checking by community is the best way to find problems. And it gave a lot of work for me as developer ;)

Now you're getting achievements for bottles, not for jumps. It was added because some people just used an autoclicker to play.

Fixed an disclaimer. Added "Early Access" caption on game start. It's because some people tell us bad words about game forgetting that it's in Early Access yet. 

Added an instruction because some people asked us about how to play the game.

Fixed results display. There was a bug when bottle score was showed instead of bottle highscore.

Relocated fullscreen button. One good person found a bug when on 4k resolution he couldn't get 16:9 image, only 4:3. Now for him it's only one way to play, but we'll try to fix it in future updates.

Added total runned distance and total collected bottles to menu. Also added highscores to menu. We just didn't know where to put this data so we put it into the main menu.

That's all changes for today. Stay with us, report bugs, send ideas and run as far as you can ;D

notes.title: First day hotfixes
notes.content:
The first day after coming out to early access ended.

Sorry cheaters, but now you can't use cheats.
Fixed bug when you could fall out from map and don't die.

Added Russian language support.
Added disclaimer: don' forget that alcohol isn't good for your health!

Changed power of second jump.
Now you don't get achievement for second jump because it's too easy to get them all.

Now trees aren't moving in pause menu.
Added player model to the main menu.

Stay with us and remember: we're doing our best to improve game quality.
